description.en: Japanese TTS with RF and MeanFlow checkpoints, supporting zero-shot voice cloning, automatic duration prediction, multimodal voice design, and emoji-style control.
description.zh: 日语 TTS，提供 RF 与 MeanFlow 检查点，支持零样本音色克隆、自动时长预测、多模态音色设计与 emoji 风格控制。

language.en: Text language code; Irodori-TTS supports Japanese only.
language.zh: 文本语言代码；Irodori-TTS 仅支持日语。

no_ref.en: Use no-reference generation; default true unless a speaker reference is provided.
no_ref.zh: 使用无参考生成；默认 true，除非提供了说话人参考。

num_inference_steps.en: Sampling steps; omitted uses 40 for RF checkpoints or 4 for MeanFlow checkpoints.
num_inference_steps.zh: 采样步骤；省略对 RF 检查点使用 40 或对 MeanFlow 检查点使用 4。

duration_sec.en: Target duration in seconds; omitted or nonpositive values select predicted duration.
duration_sec.zh: 目标持续时间（以秒为单位）；省略或非正值选择预测持续时间。

duration_scale.en: Predicted-duration multiplier; must be > 0 when set; default 1.0.
duration_scale.zh: 预测持续时间乘数；设置时必须 > 0；默认 1.0。

min_duration_sec.en: Minimum generated duration in seconds; must be > 0 and no greater than max_duration_sec; default 0.5.
min_duration_sec.zh: 最短生成持续时间（以秒为单位）；必须 > 0 且不大于 max_duration_sec；默认 0.5。

max_duration_sec.en: Maximum generated duration in seconds; must be at least min_duration_sec; default 30. Must be > 0.
max_duration_sec.zh: 最大生成持续时间（以秒为单位）；必须至少为 min_duration_sec；默认 30。必须 > 0。

text_guidance_scale.en: Text classifier-free guidance scale; default 3.0. Nonpositive values disable the corresponding CFG branch.
text_guidance_scale.zh: 无文本分类器指导量表；默认 3.0。非正值禁用相应的 CFG 分支。

speaker_guidance_scale.en: Speaker classifier-free guidance scale; default 5.0. Nonpositive values disable the corresponding CFG branch.
speaker_guidance_scale.zh: 无说话人分类器指导量表；默认 5.0。非正值禁用相应的 CFG 分支。

caption_guidance_scale.en: Caption classifier-free guidance scale; default 3.0. Nonpositive values disable the corresponding CFG branch.
caption_guidance_scale.zh: 无字幕分类器的指导量表；默认 3.0。非正值禁用相应的 CFG 分支。

guidance_scale.en: Override all classifier-free guidance scales when set. Nonpositive values disable the corresponding CFG branch.
guidance_scale.zh: 设置后覆盖所有无分类器的指导尺度。非正值禁用相应的 CFG 分支。

guidance_mode.en: Classifier-free guidance combination mode; default independent.
guidance_mode.zh: 无分类器引导的组合方式；默认 independent。

guidance_min_t.en: Minimum diffusion timestep value where guidance is active; default 0.5. The parser does not enforce a nonnegative bound.
guidance_min_t.zh: 指导处于活动状态时的最小扩散时间步长值；默认 0.5。解析器不强制执行非负边界。

guidance_max_t.en: Maximum diffusion timestep value where guidance is active; default 1.0. The parser does not enforce a nonnegative bound.
guidance_max_t.zh: 指导处于活动状态时的最大扩散时间步长值；默认 1.0。解析器不强制执行非负边界。

seed.en: Unsigned 32-bit generation seed in [0, 4294967295]; omitted uses a random seed.
seed.zh: [0, 4294967295] 中的无符号 32 位生成种子；省略使用随机种子。

trim_tail.en: Trim trailing silence-like samples; default true.
trim_tail.zh: 裁剪末尾类似静音的采样；默认 true。

stream_frames_per_event.en: Codec latent frames per streaming audio event; default 12 (0.48 seconds at 25 Hz).
stream_frames_per_event.zh: 每个流式音频事件的 codec latent 帧数；默认 12（25 Hz 下 0.48 秒）。

instruct.en: Natural-language voice or style instruction describing target voice identity, style, or emotion; supported only by caption-conditioned checkpoints. Legacy instruction and caption are accepted as aliases.
instruct.zh: 描述目标音色身份、风格或情绪的自然语言指令；仅 caption 条件检查点支持。仍接受旧 instruction/caption 别名。

speaker_embedding_file.en: Speaker Inversion embedding (*.speaker.safetensors written by Irodori-TTS training) used as the speaker condition instead of reference audio; use it with the base checkpoint it was trained on. Cannot be combined with reference audio or no_ref=true.
speaker_embedding_file.zh: Speaker Inversion 嵌入（Irodori-TTS 训练生成的 *.speaker.safetensors），用作说话人条件而非参考音频；需与训练它的基础检查点搭配。不能与参考音频或 no_ref=true 同时使用。

reference_duration_sec.en: Trim reference audio to its first reference_duration_sec seconds before encoding it, as Python Irodori-TTS does; default is the checkpoint's ref_max_seconds (30 when it has none); 0 keeps the whole reference.
reference_duration_sec.zh: 编码参考音频前，仅保留前 reference_duration_sec 秒；默认使用检查点 ref_max_seconds（无则为 30）；0 表示保留完整参考。

t_schedule_mode.en: RF Euler timestep schedule: linear or sway; default linear.
t_schedule_mode.zh: RF Euler 时间步调度：linear 或 sway；默认 linear。

sway_coeff.en: Sway Sampling coefficient; must be finite and produce strictly decreasing timesteps. Default -1.0.
sway_coeff.zh: Sway Sampling 系数；必须为有限值并产生严格递减的时间步；默认 -1.0。

text_chunk_mode.en: Text chunk policy; word_budget also accepts the legacy spelling default.
text_chunk_mode.zh: 文本分块策略；word_budget 也接受旧拼写 default。

text_chunk_size.en: Maximum characters per text chunk; default 100, or the model text-token window if smaller.
text_chunk_size.zh: 每个文本分块的最大字符数；默认 100，或模型文本 token 窗口更小时取后者。
